description: The Pro equivalence report (server/pro/equivalence.ts, as a member downloads it under the equivalents panel): an IEC power cable in mm² against its North American counterpart in the same role (low voltage: XHHW-2 or USE-2 / RHW-2 (UL 44) or THHN / THWN-2 (UL 83) at the smallest AWG / kcmil size whose area is at least the IEC section; medium voltage: UL 1072 MV-105, the conductor compared, the wall not), value by value: conductor size and resistance (IEC 60228:2004, NEC Chapter 9 Table 8), insulation wall, voltage, normal temperature (IEC 60502-1 / -2 Table 3, NEC Table 310.16), the compound limits (IEC 60502-1 Table 15, UL 1581 Tables 50.231 and 50.182) and the flame tests (IEC 60332-1-2 against VW-1, IEC 60332-3-24 against FT4: not equivalent), each with its source and seen level, as lines and as the report file (Markdown or plain text). Never a statement that the two are interchangeable: the buyer's specification decides. Always paid: the site gives it to members only. input: {format?: md | txt (the report file; default md)}. $0.50 per calculation in USDC with x402; no free allowance; a list of up to 50 items at $0.50 per item, one payment.
